user_story.i_want: the evaluator assessment data model defined and created
user_story.so_that: evaluator scores and structured comments have a proper backing object

why_this_story_exists: Multiple evaluator stories (BH-1000–BH-1005) reference AAR_Submission__c or an implied evaluator record, but no story has ever defined this object. Without it, the entire BH-1118 epic has no data model to build against. This story closes that gap.

validation_rules.name: VR_Rating_Required_On_Submit
validation_rules.error_message: Rating is required before submitting evaluation.

validation_rules.name: VR_Comment_Required_On_Submit
validation_rules.error_message: At least one comment field is required.

validation_rules.name: VR_Lock_After_Submit
validation_rules.logic: If Status__c was already 'Submitted' (PRIORVALUE), block edits to Rating__c, Strengths__c, Concerns__c, Recommendations__c
validation_rules.implementation_hint: Use ISCHANGED() against the locked fields combined with PRIORVALUE(Status__c) = 'Submitted'

access_levels.access: Create/Edit on own records when Status = Draft
Read all evaluations within their Institute

field_history_tracking.cross_ref: Per BH-1126 Mar 2026 revision — evaluator history moved from AAR_Record__c to here

acceptance_criteria: AAR_Evaluation__c custom object created with all fields above
Page layout configured: Rating + comment fields prominently displayed
Evaluator permission set has Create/Edit on own records (Status = Draft)
Field history enabled for Rating__c, Status__c, Evaluation_Date__c
Related list added to AAR_Record__c page (Evaluations section)

dependencies.description: AAR_Record__c must exist first — this is a child object

cross_references.BH-1010: Evaluator FLS on Evaluator_Comments__c / Evaluator_Score__c / Evaluator_Recommendation__c referenced fields on AAR_Submission__c — those should be reconciled to use this object (AAR_Evaluation__c) and its actual fields (Strengths__c, Concerns__c, Recommendations__c, Rating__c)
cross_references.BH-1126: Field history tracking on Rating__c, Status__c, Evaluation_Date__c is shared scope — coordinate to avoid duplicate config

open_actions: Reconcile field names with BH-1010 — that ticket references AAR_Submission__c.Evaluator_Comments__c / Evaluator_Score__c / Evaluator_Recommendation__c which do not match this object's field names. Decide whether BH-1010 should be updated to reference AAR_Evaluation__c.Rating__c / Strengths__c / Concerns__c / Recommendations__c.
Confirm Institute Director read-all-within-Institute access is achievable via the same Experience Cloud Account-scoped sharing rule used for AAR_Record__c (per BH-1010 Apr 2026 decision)
Decide whether VR_Lock_After_Submit is implemented as a validation rule (using ISCHANGED + PRIORVALUE) or via record-type/page-layout field-set permissions
